messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Annex I, 3.5.1

3.5.1. Batteries The battery housing must be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent the electrolyte being ejected on to the operator in the event of rollover or tipover and to avoid the accumulation of vapours in places occupied by operators. Machinery must be designed and constructed in such a way that the battery can be disconnected with the aid of an easily accessible device provided for that purpose.

Battery housing | mustAvoidVapourAccumulation | accumulation of vapours in places occupied by operators | | and to avoid the accumulation of vapours in places occupied by operators
Machinery | mustAllowBatteryDisconnection | battery disconnection | | Machinery must be designed and constructed in such a way that the battery can be disconnected
Battery disconnection | mustUseDevice | easily accessible device provided for that purpose | | with the aid of an easily accessible device provided for that purpose
